The '''Yevethan cargo ship''' was a [[Transport/Legends|transport]] used by the [[Yevetha]]s in the [[Koornacht Cluster/Legends|Koornacht Cluster]].

==Characteristics==
The vessels were spherical in shape, similar to the [[Aramadia-class thrustship|''Aramadia''-class thrustships]].<ref name="CTD">''[[Cracken's Threat Dossier]]''</ref>

==History==
During the opening phase of the [[Black Fleet Crisis]], many cargo ships were mistaken for thrustships, which led to an overestimation of the Yevethan military might.<ref name="CTD" />
